JSON Formatter

Paste JSON to tidy it up, check it for mistakes, shrink it, or sort its keys — with colours, and the exact line and column of any error.

Runs on your device Works offline
Ctrl↵ to format
Output 
Formatted JSON appears here.

Validation

Input is parsed with the browser’s strict JSON.parse. Errors point to the exact line and column, with a snippet of the surrounding text.

Format Ctrl↵
Search tools CtrlK

How it works

  1. 1Paste your JSONIt’s checked as you type.
  2. 2Tidy or shrink itPretty-print, minify or sort the keys.
  3. 3Fix mistakes fastErrors show the exact line and column.

Clean JSON, quickly

Pretty-printing makes API responses and config files readable; minifying strips whitespace for transport; sorting keys makes two documents easy to diff. Large documents stay on your machine — nothing is uploaded.
